jessica-cs: FYI customer (JStewart) sent over a bespoke security assessment this morning — they want: retention evidence, export audit logs, and key rotation proof. They also reported an API 401 spike during their CSV export yesterday. Need owners, repro steps, and a deliverable list. Due: EOD Friday if possible.

jstewart-cust: thanks. we need a sample log export showing the auth events, and a short statement about key rotation cadence + HSM attestation (we can accept an exported cert). also will need a CAIQ-style matrix filled for a couple controls. deadline is Friday 17:00 UTC.

samir-eng: copying in infra. can you share the export id and the approximate time of the 401s? i can start pulling logs.

jessica-cs: export id `exp_2026_0042`; spike window ~2026-03-12T03:05-03:20Z. customer saw ~120 failures, mostly 401. billing also spiked around that window per their message.

samir-eng: starting with auth logs. running quick grep on audit stream — snippet below (sanitized):

```
2026-03-12T03:06:12Z auth-service INFO method=Export v=1 user=j.stewart event=token_validation status=401 reason=expired_kv_cache
2026-03-12T03:06:13Z gateway WARN request_id=abc123 route=/v1/exports/exp_2026_0042 latency_ms=15 status=401
2026-03-12T03:07:01Z keymgr INFO rotate_job run_id=rot-2026-03-12 status=started
2026-03-12T03:07:05Z keymgr INFO rotate_job run_id=rot-2026-03-12 status=completed duration_ms=3100
```

This looks like a rotation job overlapped with the export window. hypothesis: short KV cache invalidation caused tokens to fail while rotation pushed new key material.

dina-security: thanks — for the questionnaire we need: date of last key rotation, rotation schedule (e.g., monthly), the HSM vendor + attestation doc (or reference to the cert store), audit log retention policy (how long we keep signed logs), and a sample of the exported audit CSV with event types enumerated. please keep the sample redacted for PII.

jessica-cs: note to self: customer asked for a simple acceptance statement they can include in their audit binder (one paragraph) about our retention + rotation practices. we should draft.

samir-eng: provisional repro steps for engineers/customer to reproduce the 401 spike locally:
1) kick off a long export for a large workspace (use `exp_2026_0042` as a template)
2) trigger on-demand key rotation with `POST /internal/keymgr/rotate?force=true` at the same time as export
3) watch gateway and auth logs for 401s within the export window

I'll attach a small script they can run if they want. if we confirm, fix options: (a) make rotation wait for in-flight exports to finish, (b) refresh token-cache atomically, or (c) add graceful fallback to previous key for N seconds.

opsbot: ticket created: CS-7891 — "Bespoke assessment: export 401s + rotation evidence" assigned to samir-eng, dina-security, jessica-cs. ETA: Fri 17:00 UTC. :spiral_calendar:

jstewart-cust: do you have a preferred format for the CAIQ-style answers? we can import a CSV.

dina-security: we have a template we use internally. i'll paste the important fields (retention_period, rotation_frequency, hsm_attestation_ref, log_export_path) and a short example response. we'll send the template and a one-paragraph attestation draft.

jessica-cs: action items
- samir-eng: produce a redacted audit log export for exp_2026_0042 + timeline showing token failures (owner)
- samir-eng: confirm repro script and recommended mitigation (owner)
- dina-security: provide CAIQ-style template + one-paragraph attestation draft (owner)
- jessica-cs: coordinate delivery to customer and confirm deadline (owner)

pls react when you pick up an item. :thumbsup:

samir-eng: picking up the log export now, will drop link when ready. expect ~30–45m.

dina-security: drafting template, sending in thread in 20m.

jessica-cs: thanks all. if we need legal sign-off on attestation i'll loop them in but aim to keep initial deliverable to the three artifacts (redacted logs, rotation statement, CAIQ-style answers).

jstewart-cust: appreciated — looking forward to the sample logs and the template. thanks for the quick turnaround. :pray:
